meta.title: MCP Probe Kit v4 Tool Catalog - 24/30/34 Surfaces and One-line Calls
meta.description: Complete MCP Probe Kit v4 tool catalog: 24 model tools by default, 30 with Memory, a 34-tool full compatibility surface, plus one App-only action. Every tool includes a copyable one-line call.
meta.keywords: AI development tools, code generation tools, code review tools, Git automation, UI generation, code refactoring, performance optimization, security scanning

page.subtitle: 24 model-visible tools by default, 30 with Memory, a 34-tool full compatibility surface, plus one App-only action

start_feature.description: Complete feature development workflow orchestration: bootstrap graph baseline → refresh GitNexus index → narrow scope → generate specs → estimate workload
start_feature.usage: Used to start the full feature flow, backfill graph-insights when missing, then use GitNexus query/context/impact analysis to narrow scope before spec and estimation
start_feature.prompt: Use start_feature to build this feature: <goal, scope, and acceptance criteria>

start_bugfix.description: Bug fix workflow: graph baseline → GitNexus → SRC-8 root-cause (TBP-inspired) → fix → tests → memorize
start_bugfix.usage: Use it for bugs, regressions, and anomalies; it backfills graph-insights first and uses GitNexus to constrain boundary and impact before TBP RCA
start_bugfix.prompt: Use start_bugfix to fix this issue: <symptom, error, and reproduction steps>

start_onboard.description: Project onboarding workflow: generate context documentation to help new members quickly understand the project
start_onboard.usage: Help new members quickly understand project structure, tech stack, and development standards
start_onboard.prompt: Use the start_onboard tool for this task: <describe your request>

start_ralph.description: Ralph Wiggum Loop automated development, start loop development process with multiple safety protections enabled by default
start_ralph.usage: Start automated loop development, AI will continuously iterate until goal is achieved or safety limits are reached
start_ralph.prompt: Use the start_ralph tool for this task: <describe your request>

start_product.description: Complete product design workflow orchestration: PRD → prototype docs → design system → HTML prototype → project context update
start_product.usage: One-click completion from requirements to HTML prototype, generating directly demonstrable product prototypes
start_product.prompt: Use start_product to design from requirements to prototype: <product idea and target users>

start_ui.description: Unified UI development entry: check design system → generate component catalog → search/generate templates → render code
start_ui.usage: One-click completion of entire UI development process, from design system to final code
start_ui.prompt: Use start_ui to design and implement: <page or component, style, and interactions>

code_review.description: Intelligent code review, analyzing code from multiple dimensions including security, performance, quality, style, and best practices
code_review.usage: Comprehensive code quality review, outputting structured issue list (severity/category/suggestion)
code_review.prompt: Use code_review to review: <file, directory, or diff scope>

fix_bug.description: SRC-8 guidance-only bug RCA (TBP-inspired): injects rootCauseWorksheet and gates; Agent produces rootCauseAnalysis
fix_bug.usage: Use it when you need to find the true cause first and close the chain from symptom and boundary to repair
fix_bug.prompt: Use the fix_bug tool for this task: <describe your request>

refactor.description: Refactoring suggestion tool, analyzing code structure, providing refactoring steps, risk assessment, and rollback plan
refactor.usage: Analyze code structure, provide refactoring suggestions, refactoring steps, and risk assessment
refactor.prompt: Use the refactor tool for this task: <describe your request>

gencommit.description: Automatically generate Git commit messages compliant with Conventional Commits specification based on code changes
gencommit.usage: Generate commit messages compliant with Conventional Commits specification based on code changes
gencommit.prompt: Use gencommit to create a conventional commit message from the current changes.

git_work_report.description: Generate work reports (daily/periodic) based on Git diff analysis, intelligently extracting actual work content
git_work_report.usage: Automatically read Git commits for specified dates, analyze diff content, generate concise professional work reports. If direct command fails, provides temporary script solution (auto-deleted after execution)
git_work_report.prompt: Use the git_work_report tool for this task: <describe your request>

gentest.description: Generate unit tests, supporting Jest/Vitest/Mocha frameworks, including edge cases and mock data
gentest.usage: Generate unit test code, including edge cases and mocks
gentest.prompt: Use the gentest tool for this task: <describe your request>

init_project.description: Generate requirement/design/task documents following Spec-Driven Development approach
init_project.usage: Generate requirement/design/task documents following Spec-Driven Development approach
init_project.prompt: Use init_project to turn this one-line idea into a complete project specification: <idea>

init_project_context.description: Build a delegated project-context writing plan: MCP writes AGENTS.md and layout; Agent writes modular docs and graph-insights per plan
init_project_context.usage: Call when context is missing; returns metadata.plan, pendingFiles, and documentation status (exists/written/agent_action_required). Agent must write pending files manually.
init_project_context.prompt: Use init_project_context to generate complete context and a graph baseline for the current project.

add_feature.description: Generate new feature specification documents (requirements/design/task list) based on project context
add_feature.usage: Generate new feature specification documents (requirements/design/task list) based on project context
add_feature.prompt: Use the add_feature tool for this task: <describe your request>

check_spec.description: Validate that a written feature spec (requirements/design/tasks.md) is complete: detects leftover placeholders, missing sections, missing FR/acceptance criteria, and FRs not in the coverage matrix
check_spec.usage: Call after writing the spec and before implementation; if it fails, fill the gaps per the report and rerun
check_spec.prompt: Use the check_spec tool for this task: <describe your request>

estimate.description: Estimate development workload, output story points, time range (optimistic/normal/pessimistic), risk points
estimate.usage: Estimate development workload, output story points, time range (optimistic/normal/pessimistic), risk points
estimate.prompt: Use the estimate tool for this task: <describe your request>

interview.description: Requirements interview tool, clarifying requirements through structured questioning to avoid misunderstandings and rework
interview.usage: Requirements interview tool, clarifying requirements through structured questioning before development
interview.prompt: Use the interview tool for this task: <describe your request>

ask_user.description: AI proactive questioning tool, supporting single or multiple questions, providing options, marking importance
ask_user.usage: AI proactively asks users questions, supporting single or multiple questions, providing options, marking importance
ask_user.prompt: Use the ask_user tool for this task: <describe your request>

ui_design_system.description: Intelligent design system generator, generating complete design specifications based on product type reasoning
ui_design_system.usage: Based on product type and requirements, use AI reasoning engine to generate complete design system recommendations
ui_design_system.prompt: Use the ui_design_system tool for this task: <describe your request>

ui_search.description: Search UI/UX database, including colors, icons, charts, components, design patterns, etc.
ui_search.usage: Search UI/UX database using BM25 algorithm for intelligent search
ui_search.prompt: Use the ui_search tool for this task: <describe your request>

sync_ui_data.description: Sync UI/UX data to local cache, supporting automatic update checking and forced sync
sync_ui_data.usage: Sync UI/UX data to local cache, downloading latest data from npm package uipro-cli
sync_ui_data.prompt: Use the sync_ui_data tool for this task: <describe your request>

code_insight.description: Code graph insight tool, bridging GitNexus to analyze call chains, context, and impact (auto-degrades when unavailable)
code_insight.usage: Refresh the GitNexus index, perform task-level call-chain/context/impact analysis, and persist results to docs/graph-insights plus the project-context index
code_insight.prompt: Use code_insight to analyze: <entry point, call chain, or impact question>

architecture.description: Independent ARC-8 architecture capability for assessing, designing, validating, and checking drift across boundaries, dependencies, data ownership, public contracts, migration, and rollback
architecture.usage: Call assess/design/validate/drift directly; establish current facts and protected invariants before comparing alternatives, designing the transition, and checking the real implementation
architecture.prompt: Use architecture with ARC-8 for: <architecture goal, scope, constraints, and current problem>

search_memory.description: Semantic search across the shared memory pool, with optional type/tags preference
search_memory.usage: Use outside start_* to find historical bugfixes or patterns; text output includes id/score/summary/description and a --- content --- body (default 1500 chars; use read_memory_asset for unlimited full text)
search_memory.prompt: Use search_memory to find prior experience related to: <problem or keywords>

read_memory_asset.description: Read the full content and metadata of a stored memory asset by asset ID
read_memory_asset.usage: Use after search_memory or orchestration hits; text output includes the full --- content --- body plus structuredContent.asset
read_memory_asset.prompt: Use the read_memory_asset tool for this task: <describe your request>

memorize_asset.description: Persist high-value code, spec, or pattern assets into the vector memory system for later reuse
memorize_asset.usage: Use after implementation to store reusable assets into the Qdrant + embedding memory backend
memorize_asset.prompt: Use memorize_asset to store this validated knowledge: <summary, content, evidence, applicability>

update_memory_asset.description: Update an existing memory asset by asset ID while preserving the same ID
update_memory_asset.usage: Use to fix summary, content, or tags on an existing asset; content changes trigger re-embedding
update_memory_asset.prompt: Use the update_memory_asset tool for this task: <describe your request>

delete_memory_asset.description: Delete a stored memory asset by asset ID from the shared memory pool
delete_memory_asset.usage: Use to remove outdated, incorrect, or duplicate assets; confirm with read_memory_asset before deleting
delete_memory_asset.prompt: Use the delete_memory_asset tool for this task: <describe your request>

scan_and_extract_patterns.description: Extract reusable patterns from a code snippet, file, or directory before deciding whether to store them into memory
scan_and_extract_patterns.usage: Use for pattern mining first, then optionally follow with memorize_asset to persist the best candidates
scan_and_extract_patterns.prompt: Use the scan_and_extract_patterns tool for this task: <describe your request>

workflow.description: Intelligent development workflow routing that selects the precise start_*, analysis, specification, or Memory entry from the complete task intent.
workflow.usage: Use when the correct tool is unclear or when the Agent might skip the standard workflow.
workflow.prompt: Use workflow to select and execute the correct development flow for: <complete task>

plan_heartbeat.description: Persists completed steps, evidence, open items, and revision for a resumable Delegated Plan checkpoint.
plan_heartbeat.usage: Call on first execution and after every completed, skipped, or blocked step.
plan_heartbeat.prompt: Use plan_heartbeat to record progress, evidence, and open items for plan <plan_id>.

resume_plan.description: Restores a plan from the project checkpoint and recomputes executable and blocked steps from dependencies.
resume_plan.usage: Call after interruption, server restart, or Agent handoff.

converge.description: Checks plan steps plus requirements, specification, implementation, test, and review evidence before delivery or long-term Memory writes.
converge.usage: Call after implementation and validation; persist Memory only when passed=true.
converge.prompt: Use converge to verify whether this plan can close: <plan_id>

list_memory_assets.description: Memory Center browsing action that lists memory summaries by update time with filters and pagination.
list_memory_assets.usage: App-only action used after MCP Apps capability negotiation; hidden from the model.
